Multi-distribution application environment CLI

Usage: unifier <command> [options]

Common commands:
  init       choose distributions and prepare one daily container per distribution
  configure  update the enabled set; unchecking never stops or deletes
  list       show distribution configuration and container state
  dirs       show private directories and system-view state
  path       print only the real absolute private directory path
  ls         list real guest subdirectories without starting the container
  install    install software with the native transaction in an enabled distribution
  run        run a registered application with the existing on-demand lease
  start      start the unique container for one distribution
  stop       stop it, refusing to force a stop while tasks are using it
  adopt      advanced: read-only adoption of a legacy deployment identity
  language   show or change the interface language
  help       show help, optionally for one command

Run 'unifier help COMMAND' for usage. Low-level diagnostics remain env/pkg/app/project/view.

init 帮助

用法：unifier init [--target TARGET ...] [--none] [--desktop] [--network pasta|none] [--yes]

选项：
  --target TARGET    选择发行版；可重复。只准备所选项，不拉取未选项。
  --none             明确选择空集合：只安装 CLI，容器数为 0。
  --desktop          显式创建桌面环境；默认无桌面，pasta + keep-id。
  --network pasta|none 默认 pasta，安装软件需要网络。
  --yes              跳过确认（非交互模式必须显式选择）。

示例：
  unifier init
  unifier init --target debian13 --target arch --yes

install help

Usage: unifier install [--target TARGET] [--exec PATH] [--app ID] [--package NAME] [--gui] FILE|PACKAGE ... [-- ARGS]

Options:
  --target           only an enabled distribution is used; otherwise configure is required and no instance is created.
  --exec PATH        explicit application entry; a path or guest command name.
  --app ID           registered application id; defaults to the entry basename.
  --package NAME     installed package name for a local file, used for entry discovery.
  --gui              declare a desktop application; a headless container is refused rather than run silently.

Examples:
  unifier install ./software.deb --exec /usr/bin/freecad
  unifier install --target arch freecad --exec /usr/bin/freecad
